purpose: One fixed CPU campaign for DistanceGuard experimental API 1.0.0 eligibility; no MAIN rebuild or default integration
service: Factory + prepare for deferred + first common Push_N query + q followups + all module calls, allocations, copies, maintenance, module release/destroy + separately timed consumer output deallocation. Independent oracle validation excluded and separately timed. Ready moves factory/prepare into separately reported historical preparation; history-inclusive service adds it back. Graph API construction and one-time dlopen startup are outside batches and separately identified.
comparison: Identical source lists, owned output lifetime, counters enabled as deployed API. First query Push_N for every mode. No implicit result reuse except named EXACT_REUSE control. Existing deployed modules have two copies; matched controls and DG one copy. Never pool previous non-API timings.
ordering: Rotate mode order by round/session, reverse alternate round/session, then mirrored reverse sweep. Average two sweeps before ratios; sessions are fresh sequential processes, not concurrent.
gate: DG_FRONTIER must have paired median service ratio <0.95, >=32/40 paired wins, and all five session median ratios <0.95 against EVERY strong comparator (TABLE/LAST deployed and matched, OLD_P2, RIE, RIE_TABLE, EXACT_REUSE) and DG_COUNT/DG_RADIUS. Ready gate separately from history-inclusive gate. No optimization reruns after negative result.
uncertainty: Report 40 mirrored pairs, five session medians/range, win count, sweep-order discrepancy, deterministic 10000-resample session-cluster bootstrap median-ratio 95% interval. Five sessions and selected fixtures limit inference; no population or GPU claim.
phase_diagnostics: Separate timer-enabled DSOs, one process three mirrored rounds q32, same inputs. Algorithm, owned allocation/copy, maintenance, reverse build, prepare, release, residual dispatch/adapter time measured separately. Intrusive clocks excluded from primary campaign; no cross-run subtraction.
stop: One campaign only; HOLD if no reproducible practical full-service advantage. No GPU or paid resources. No automatic merge.
